pairs.target: dìèrrì xiàwǔ , nài lěi lái xuégōng zhǎo tǎ wéi , méi cuī tā xiàtáijiē , xiān bǎ yìzhāng zhé guò liǎngcì de zhǐ tān zài láng biān .
pairs.english: The next afternoon, Nerai came to the academy to find Tavi; she did not hurry him down the steps, first spreading a sheet of paper which had been folded twice beside the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 第二日下午，奈蕾来学宫找塔维，没催他下台阶，先把一张折过两次的纸摊在廊边。

pairs.target: huò háng yuē le táng ruì hé dù róng , jīnrì yào bǎ hùsòng de shì dìng xiàlái , míngzǎo cóng nánmén zǒu , nài lěi wèn tā hái xiǎng buxiǎng qù tīng .
pairs.english: The freight firm had arranged to meet Tang Rui and Du Rong to settle the escort arrangement today, with departure from the south gate tomorrow morning; Nerai asked whether he still wanted to go and listen.
pairs.hanzi: 货行约了唐芮和杜嵘，今日要把护送的事定下来，明早从南门走，奈蕾问他还想不想去听。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng cèzi jiā zài yèxià , zǒu píngdì shí zuǒ xī yǐjīng bù téng , dào le huò háng réng tiāo kào mén de gāo dèng zuò , méi bǎ tuǐ sāi dào zhuōtuǐ zhījiān .
pairs.english: Tavi tucked his notebook under his arm; his left knee no longer hurt when walking on level ground, but at the freight firm he still chose a tall stool near the door, without squeezing his leg between the table legs.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将册子夹在腋下，走平地时左膝已经不疼，到了货行仍挑靠门的高凳坐，没把腿塞到桌腿之间。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng fàng zhe nà fèn zhǐ dào hé chà de lù tú , guǎnshì yòng zhènzhǐ yāzhù xià jiǎo , shuō lùshang de měi yírì dōu yào fùqián , bùnéng yù zhe yípiàn lànní biàn jiào chē děng zhe .
pairs.english: On the table lay that route map, the one extending only to River Fork; the manager held down a lower corner with a paperweight, saying each and every day on the road cost money, and carts could not be made to wait at every patch of mud.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上放着那份只到河岔的路图，管事用镇纸压住下角，说路上的每一日都要付钱，不能遇着一片烂泥便叫车等着。

pairs.target: dù róng méi jiē tā dehuà , xiān wèn dài duōshǎo chē , tīngjiàn liǎngliàng , biàn jiāng zhǐ wǎng zìjǐ miànqián lā , zhǐ zhù nánpō hòutou nàduàn zhǎilù .
pairs.english: Du Rong did not take up his remark, first asking how many carts they were taking; hearing two, he pulled the paper in front of himself and pointed to the narrow stretch beyond South Slope.
pairs.hanzi: 杜嵘没接他的话，先问带多少车，听见两辆，便将纸往自己面前拉，指住南坡后头那段窄路。

pairs.target: ruò qián chē guòbúqù , hòu chē yě bùnéng jǐshànglái , tā yào chēbǎshì tīng tíng , bùnéng zhǐ zài xiě jiàqián shí cái suàn tā shì hùlù de rén .
pairs.english: If the front cart could not get through, the one behind must not crowd forward either; he wanted the drivers to obey a halt, rather than count him as the route guard only when writing down the price.
pairs.hanzi: 若前车过不去，后车也不能挤上来，他要车把式听停，不能只在写价钱时才算他是护路的人。

pairs.target: guǎnshì shuō huòzhǔ kěndìng yào wèn wèishénme tíng , táng ruì shuō kěyǐ wèn , děng rén jiǎoxià zhànwěn le zài wèn , bié zài tā shǒulǐ ná zhe dùn shí cóng hòutou tuīchē .
pairs.english: The manager said the cargo owners would certainly ask why they had stopped; Tang Rui said they could ask, but should ask again only once people were standing securely, and should not push a cart from behind while she held a shield.
pairs.hanzi: 管事说货主肯定要问为什么停，唐芮说可以问，等人脚下站稳了再问，别在她手里拿着盾时从后头推车。

pairs.target: tā shuō de bù xiǎng , guǎnshì kàn le tā yíhuìer , jiāng yuánlái nà xíng bùxǔ wùqī huàdiào , lìng xiě yùzǔ jì míng yuángù , huíchéng zài hé .
pairs.english: She spoke quietly; the manager watched her a while, crossed out the original line forbidding delays, and instead wrote that reasons for obstructions must be recorded and checked upon return to the city.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得不响，管事看了她一会儿，将原来那行不许误期划掉，另写遇阻记明缘故，回城再核。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhǐzhe hé chà yǐwài de kòngbái , shuō zhèfèn wěituō zhǐ dào zhèlǐ , bié bǎ yíduàn hùsòng xiěchéng wǎnghòu dōu néng zǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai pointed to the blank beyond River Fork, saying this commission went only this far; they should not write one stretch of escort work as though everything beyond was passable.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾指着河岔以外的空白，说这份委托只到这里，别把一段护送写成往后都能走。

pairs.target: guǎnshì diǎntóu , méi jiào tā tì méi qùguò de lù dānbǎo , què yòu wèn děng yǔ yě suàn yírì me , dù róng shuō rén yě zài yǔ lǐ , búhuì yīnwèi méi zǒu jiù búyòng chī .
pairs.english: The manager nodded, not asking her to guarantee roads she had never visited, but asked whether waiting out rain counted as a day too; Du Rong said people were in the rain as well, and staying put did not mean they need not eat.
pairs.hanzi: 管事点头，没叫她替没去过的路担保，却又问等雨也算一日么，杜嵘说人也在雨里，不会因为没走就不用吃。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ děnghòu , zhéfǎn hé huíchéng jiāodài dōu shuō qīng , jiàqián fēnkāi xiě , táng ruì dúwán zìjǐ nà yífèn , cái jiāng míngzì luò shàngqù .
pairs.english: They clarified waiting, turning back and reporting on return to the city, all of it, with charges written separately; Tang Rui read her own copy through before putting her name down.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把等候、折返和回城交代都说清，价钱分开写，唐芮读完自己那一份，才将名字落上去。

pairs.target: dù róng qiānde màn , zuìhòu yìbǐ yāchū mò tuán , jiào guǎnshì bié ná tā dāng zìjǐ duō lǐng le yìdī qián , zhuōbiān zhōngyú yǒurén xiào le .
pairs.english: Du Rong signed slowly, his last stroke leaving an ink blot; he told the manager not to count it as his drawing an extra drop of money, and someone at the table finally laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 杜嵘签得慢，最后一笔压出墨团，叫管事别拿它当自己多领了一滴钱，桌边终于有人笑了。

pairs.target: hùsòng jiùcǐ dìngxià , míngzǎo liǎng rén suíchē chūmén , zǒu dào hé chà zài fǎn , yuē hǎo wǔrì hòu huíchéng jiāodài , yùzǔ biàn tuō zhànshàng sòngxìn , bù ná rìzi bīrén gǎnlù .
pairs.english: The escort was thus agreed: tomorrow morning the two would leave with the carts, reach River Fork and return, reporting in the city five days later as arranged; if obstructed, they would ask the station to send word, without letting a date force people to hurry.
pairs.hanzi: 护送就此定下，明早两人随车出门，走到河岔再返，约好五日后回城交代，遇阻便托站上送信，不拿日子逼人赶路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìzhí méi chāhuà , jiàn dù róng yào bǎ tú hé shàng , cái wèn hé chà qián nà dào wān , zìjǐ shàng huí tīngjiàn tā zhǐ liǎngcì , jiūjìng zhǐ de shì nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi had kept silent throughout; seeing Du Rong about to fold the map, only then did he ask about that bend before River Fork, which he had heard him indicate twice last time: exactly where was he pointing?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一直没插话，见杜嵘要把图合上，才问河岔前那道弯，自己上回听见他指两次，究竟指的是哪里。

pairs.target: dù róng jiāng tú chóngxīn yāpíng , wèn tā shì kàn chē zǒu de , háishì kàn rén zǒu de , tǎ wéi yì zhèng , shuō zìjǐ jìng méi wèn guò zhè liǎngyàng shìbushì tóng yìtiáo .
pairs.english: Du Rong flattened the map again, asking whether he meant the way carts went or the way people went; Tavi paused, saying he had never even asked whether those two were the same route.
pairs.hanzi: 杜嵘将图重新压平，问他是看车走的，还是看人走的，塔维一怔，说自己竟没问过这两样是不是同一条。

pairs.target: jìn hé nàtiáo néng shěng jiǎochéng , yǔ hòu què yào cǎi liǎngkuài xié shí , chē bù zǒu nàér , wǎng shānbì biān rào de cái shì tāmen dài huò yào guò de wān .
pairs.english: The one near the river could save walking distance, but after rain required stepping on two slanting stones; carts did not go there, and the bend that went round by the rock wall was the one they needed for taking goods through.
pairs.hanzi: 近河那条能省脚程，雨后却要踩两块斜石，车不走那儿，往山壁边绕的才是他们带货要过的弯。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō rújīn shí shàng yǒuméiyǒu shuǐ , jiāng liǎngchù dōu zhǐ gěi tǎ wéi , jiào tā huílái wèn jiàn guò de rén , búyào ná tú shàng de lánxiàn dāng jīnrì de shuǐmiàn .
pairs.english: He did not say whether there was any water on the stones now, pointing both of the two places out to Tavi and telling him to ask those who had seen them after returning, rather than treat the blue line on the map as today's water surface.
pairs.hanzi: 他没说如今石上有没有水，将两处都指给塔维，叫他回来问见过的人，不要拿图上的蓝线当今日的水面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zàicè shàng lìng huà yìxiǎokuài , xiān xiě chē wān , hòutou kòng zhe wèn lùmiàn , táng ruì còu guòlái kàn , shuō tā de zì bǐhuà de lù zhí .
pairs.english: Tavi drew another small section in his notebook, first writing cart bend and leaving space afterward to ask about the surface; Tang Rui leaned over to look and said his writing was straighter than the road he had drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在册上另画一小块，先写车弯，后头空着问路面，唐芮凑过来看，说他的字比画的路直。

pairs.target: tā jiāng cèzi wǎng lǐ shōu , tā què méiyǒu xiào tā , zhǐ shuō děng zìjǐ zǒu huílái , ruò hái xiǎng wèn , jiù bǎ zhè yíyè dài zhe , bié lìng huà yíchù ràng rén rèn .
pairs.english: He drew his notebook inward, but she was not laughing at him; she only said that when she came back, if he still wanted to ask, he should bring this page, not draw another place for someone to recognise.
pairs.hanzi: 他将册子往里收，她却没有笑他，只说等自己走回来，若还想问，就把这一页带着，别另画一处让人认。

pairs.target: nài lěi shōuqǐ liúgěi zìjǐ de nà fèn zhǐ , zuǒshǒu qù àn zhé kǒu shí , xiǎozhǐ luòde màn le yìdiǎn , tā huàn yòushǒu yā hǎo , méiyǒu jiāng zhǐ sāi gěi tǎ wéi tì tā ná .
pairs.english: Nerai put away the paper copy kept for herself; as her left hand pressed the fold, the little finger came down a little more slowly; she switched to her right hand to flatten it, without passing the paper to Tavi to carry for her.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾收起留给自己的那份纸，左手去按折口时，小指落得慢了一点，她换右手压好，没有将纸塞给塔维替她拿。

pairs.target: cóng huò háng chūlái , tǎ wéi méi jí zhe huí xuégōng , zhàn zài yánxià wànglewàng nánbiān , chēlún cóng shífèng lǐ diān guòqù , xiǎngshēng hěnkuài jiù bèi jiēshàng rénshēng gàizhù .
pairs.english: Coming out of the freight firm, Tavi did not hurry back to the academy; he stood under the eaves looking south, as cart wheels bumped over gaps in the stone and their sound was soon covered by street voices.
pairs.hanzi: 从货行出来，塔维没急着回学宫，站在檐下望了望南边，车轮从石缝里颠过去，响声很快就被街上人声盖住。

pairs.target: tā wèn míngrì tā shìbushì yě lái , nài lěi shuōlái sòng tāmen , zìjǐ bú shàngchē , shǒu hái méi hǎo dào néng bǎ yào zuò de dōu zuò wán .
pairs.english: He asked whether she would come tomorrow too; Nerai said she would see them off but would not board herself, her hand not yet well enough to finish everything she needed to do.
pairs.hanzi: 他问明日她是不是也来，奈蕾说来送他们，自己不上车，手还没好到能把要做的都做完。

pairs.target: " wǒ yě méi shuō yào qù . "
pairs.english: “I did not say I wanted to go either.”
pairs.hanzi: “我也没说要去。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōwán , cái fāxiànzìjǐ shuō de tài kuài , nài lěi kànzhe tā , méiyǒu tì tā bǎ zhè jù huà yuán guòqù .
pairs.english: Only after speaking did Tavi realise he had said it far too quickly; Nerai watched him, without smoothing that remark over on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说完，才发现自己说得太快，奈蕾看着他，没有替他把这句话圆过去。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , tā wèn děng shǒu hǎo le , tā shìbushì hái huì zài chūqù , tā shuō huì , zìjǐ yǒu jǐchù méi kàn wán de dìfāng , yě yǒu dāying yào huíqù de rénjiā .
pairs.english: After a while he asked whether she would go out again once her hand was better; she said yes, she had several places she had not finished looking at, and households she had promised to return to as well.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，他问等手好了，她是不是还会再出去，她说会，自己有几处没看完的地方，也有答应要回去的人家。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi tā huì shuō děng zhe tā , tīngjiàn búshì , xiōngkǒu kōng le yìdiǎn , yòu mànmàn sōng xiàlái , zhìshǎo nàtiáo lù méiyǒu yīnwèi zìjǐ hái zuòzài dèng shàng biàn hé qǐlái .
pairs.english: He had expected her to say she would wait for him; hearing otherwise left a little hollow in his chest, then slowly eased it: at least that road had not closed simply because he was still sitting on a stool.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为她会说等着他，听见不是，胸口空了一点，又慢慢松下来，至少那条路没有因为自己还坐在凳上便合起来。

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn tā míngzǎo yuànbuyuàn yìqǐ sòng , tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shuō děi xiān kànkàn zǎokè , tā shuōhǎo , suíjí jiāng nà zhāng zhǐjiā huí bāo lǐ , zhuǎnshēn tì yíngmiàn de rén ràng chūlù .
pairs.english: Nerai asked whether he would like to see them off together tomorrow morning; Tavi nodded, saying he must check his morning class first; she said all right, then tucked that paper back into her bag and turned for a person coming toward them, making room.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问他明早愿不愿一起送，塔维点头，说得先看看早课，她说好，随即将那张纸夹回包里，转身替迎面的人让出路。
